Layout Rules.text: Summary Layout Rules Define conditional field visibility and required-state rules triggered by other field values on this module's layouts. In Development

Validation Rules.text: Summary Validation Rules Refuse a record that matches a condition — on create and on edit — and show your message instead of saving it. Write the condition for the record you want to stop, as in Zoho. New Rule No validation rules yet. Create one to stop records with wrong values from being saved.

Record Locking Configuration.text: Summary Record Locking Configuration Configure conditions that prevent record edits after a trigger, such as locking a deal once it reaches a Closed stage. In Development

Map Dependency Fields.text: Summary Map Dependency Fields Limit the values of a child pick list by the value chosen in a parent pick list. A record whose child value is not allowed for its parent value is not saved. New Dependency No field dependencies yet. Create one to offer only the child values that fit the parent value.

Links.text: Summary Links Add custom action links that appear on module record views, letting users navigate to related external resources in one click. In Development

Buttons.text: Summary Buttons Add CTA buttons with URL, function, or workflow actions to list and detail views of this module's records. In Development
